description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three different models – Audio-Reasoner, Qwen-2.5-Omni, and a Random Choice baseline – across a set of tasks. The horizontal axis displays the model names, listed in the order Audio-Reasoner, Qwen-2.5-Omni, and then Audio-Reasoner again, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Three bars are present for each model name; a blue bar labeled “Audio”, a purple bar labeled “Noise”, and a dashed gray line representing “Random Choice”. For Audio-Reasoner, the “Audio” bar reaches approximately 44%, the “Noise” bar reaches approximately 24%, and the “Random Choice” line is at 30%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the “Audio” bar reaches approximately 58%, the “Noise” bar reaches approximately 32%, and the “Random Choice” line is at 30%. The bars are grouped by model name, with each group containing one “Audio” bar, one “Noise” bar, and the “Random Choice” line. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
